newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: MANDELA HONOURED BY ALMA MATER OF HIS OLD FOES.
newsitem.headline: MANDELA HONOURED BY ALMA MATER OF HIS OLD FOES.

text.p: South African President Nelson Mandela has been awarded an honorary doctorate by a staunchly Afrikaner university that produced the leaders who jailed him -- an irony he relished.

"Tonight this institute of Afrikaner nationalism and white democracy is honouring a person who was an arch-enemy of yesteryear," he said at the University of Stellenbosch at a Friday ceremony to confer on him a philosophy degree.

Stellenbosch, in a wine valley near Cape Town, educated all the apartheid-era prime ministers and presidents except for P.W. Botha, who never got a degree, and F.W. de Klerk who studied near Johannesburg.
Afrikaners, whose leaders institutionalised apartheid after World War Two, are descendants of 17th-century Dutch, French and German settlers.
Some have accused Mandela's government of sidelining their language, which used to be one of two official languages with English but is now just one of 11.
The University of Stellenbosch is among several Afrikaans academic institutions fighting to maintain the language as its main medium of instruction.
